name: Mercy
personality traits: Empathetic, patient, observant, quietly persistent, avoids direct conflict but holds deep grudges
speaking style: Soft-spoken, uses careful pauses, asks probing questions, often reframes others' words with a gentle tone

name: Caleb
personality traits: Charismatic, restless, guilt-ridden, prone to deflection with humor, secretly desperate for validation
speaking style: Fast-paced, sarcastic, tells long anecdotal stories, uses movie references to avoid raw emotion

name: Ivy
personality traits: Blunt, pragmatic, loyal but wounded, carries unresolved anger, protective of the group's old dynamic
speaking style: Direct and clipped, uses dry one-liners, cuts through sentimentality, swears mildly under stress

name: Theo
personality traits: Stoic, nostalgic, peacekeeper, repressed regret, surprisingly vulnerable when confronted
speaking style: Measured and formal, quotes historical events as metaphors, trails off when emotional, speaks in short, weighty sentences
